from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
      |> range(start: -30d)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "venti_state")
      |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "state")
      |> last()

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r["device_name"] =~ /^outdoor/ or
    r["device_name"] == "fan" or
    r["device_name"] =~ /^probe/
  )

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_sdef" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_battery" or
    r["_field"] == "rssi"
  )

  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "_field", "_measurement"])
  |> last()

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    col:
      if r._field == "rssi" then "RSSI"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" then "Temp"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" then "Hum"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse" then "TS"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_sdef" then "SDef"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_battery" then "Battery"
      else "unknown"
  }))

  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["device_name"],
    columnKey: ["col"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with

    Sensor:
      if r.device_name == "outdoor00" then "Außen 1"
      else if r.device_name == "outdoor01" then "Außen 2"
      else if r.device_name == "outdoor02" then "Außen 3"

      else if r.device_name == "probe01" then "Sonde 1"
      else if r.device_name == "probe02" then "Sonde 2"
      else if r.device_name == "probe03" then "Sonde 3"

      else if r.device_name == "fan" then "Lüfter"

      else r.device_name,

    sortKey:
      if r.device_name =~ /^outdoor/ then 1
      else if r.device_name =~ /^probe/ then 2
      else if r.device_name == "fan" then 99
      else 999
  }))

  |> sort(columns: ["sortKey", "Sensor"])

  |> group()

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_name"] =~ /^outdoor/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" or r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" or r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse")
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

sensor =
from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_name"] !~ /^outdoor/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" or
    r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

fan =
from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_name"] == "fan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_RO1_status")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._value == "ON" then 10 else 0
  }))

union(tables: [sensor, fan])

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: -2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "venti")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "stockaufbau")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with Stockaufbau: if (uint(v: r._value) * uint(v: 3600000000000)) -(uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time))  >=0  and (uint(v: r._value) * uint(v: 3600000000000)) -(uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time))  <= 1844674388946713400 then (uint(v: r._value) * uint(v: 3600000000000)) -(uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time))  else uint(v: 0)}))
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: -2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_name"] == "fan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_RO1_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] == "OFF")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ON: if uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time) >= uint(v: 600000000000) then uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time) else uint(v: 0)}))
  |> yield(name: "last")

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: -2d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device_name"] == "fan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_RO1_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] == "ON")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with OFF: if uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time) >= uint(v: 600000000000) then uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time) else uint(v: 0)}))
  |> yield(name: "last")

option v = {
  timeRangeStart: v.timeRangeStart,
  timeRangeStop: v.timeRangeStop
}

timeRangeSeconds =
    int(v: uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 1000000000

windowSize =
    if timeRangeSeconds < 3 * 24 * 3600 then 1h
    else if timeRangeSeconds < 35 * 24 * 3600 then 1d
    else 1mo

from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["device_name"] == "fan" and
      r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_RO1_status"
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._value == "ON" then 1.0 else 0.0
  }))

  |> aggregateWindow(
      every: windowSize,
      fn: mean,
      createEmpty: true
  )

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,

      _value:
        r._value *
        float(v: int(v: windowSize) / 1000000000) /
        3600.0
  }))

  |> fill(value: 0.0)

  |> yield(name: "Fan runtime (h)")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "jokley_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    (r["device_name"] =~ /^outdoor/) and
    (
      r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" or
      r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" or
      r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse" or
      r["_measurement"] == "device_frmpayload_data_sdef"
    ) and
    r["_value"] <= 100 and r["_value"] >= -100
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _value: r._value,
    _field:
      if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_temperature" then "Temperature (°C)"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_humidity" then "Humidity (%)"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_trockenmasse" then "Trockenmasse (%)"
      else if r._measurement == "device_frmpayload_data_sdef" then "SDEF"
      else r._measurement
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])  // only group by field name to make it appear in Grafana correctly
  |> max()
